title: P-10: symmetric per-set URL namespace — live-animals MIGRATES to /live-animals, / becomes a 302, signout is hoisted
recipe: No recipe covers platform URL namespacing. The script is SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §4.3 (the two export families, the REWRITTEN mount scheme `prefix = '/' + setId`, the mount table), §4.6 A-D (the ENUMERATED live-animals migration — execute it as a ticked checklist, file by file, not as a hunt), §4.2 rows 10-11 (shared/paths.js BASE and engine/journey.js cookieOptions), §4.4.5 (the rewritten router.js body), and the acceptance bar at §5 P-10. FD-16 (symmetric mounts), FD-18 (what serves `/`) and FD-19 (the signout hoist) are the three decisions this increment makes real.

§4.6 A rows 1-3. The whole file today is 15 lines (verified live): `export const BASE = ''` then pagePath, pageRoutePath, hubPath, hubRoutePath, createPath, dashboardPath (which returns a literal '/') and breadcrumbs. Rewrite it as TWO FAMILIES with `setBase()` in place of BASE.

DELETE `export const BASE` — it is a module-load capture of a value that is now per request. Add `const setBase = () => currentSetBase()` (from shared/set-context.js) and EXPORT setBase: the live-animals entry guard and pp-006's plant gateway both need it.

FAMILY 1 — ROUTE-SHAPE BUILDERS, evaluated at MODULE LOAD when controllers build their route tables, therefore PREFIX-FREE. Hapi's plugin `routes.prefix` supplies the mount, so these must NOT call setBase():
- `pageRoutePath(slug)` → `/notifications/{journeyId}/${slug}` (used by shared/kit.js:123,129 in pageRoutes)
- `hubRoutePath()` → `/notifications/{journeyId}` (used by the live-animals hub controller, ~line 169)
- `dashboardRoutePath()` [NEW] → `/` exactly (for live-animals dashboard controller.js:114, which today calls dashboardPath())
- `createRoutePath()` [NEW] → `/notifications` (for live-animals dashboard controller.js:126, which today calls createPath())

FAMILY 2 — LINK BUILDERS, evaluated per request, therefore PREFIX-BEARING via setBase():
- `pagePath(journeyId, slug)` → `${setBase()}/notifications/${journeyId}/${slug}`
- `hubPath(journeyId)` → `${setBase()}/notifications/${journeyId}`
- `createPath()` → `${setBase()}/notifications`
- `dashboardPath()` → `setBase()` — **the `|| '/'` fallback the asymmetric round-2 plan needed is DELETED** (§4.6 A row 2). Under R7 no set is mounted at '', so setBase() is never empty; keeping the fallback would hide a missing-context bug behind a plausible-looking '/'.
- `breadcrumbs(_journeyId, title)` unchanged in shape; its dashboardPath() call now resolves per set for free

WHY THE TWO NEW EXPORTS EXIST: dashboardPath() and createPath() are currently used BOTH as route paths (at module load) and as links (at request time) in the same file. Under a prefix those two uses must produce DIFFERENT strings, so they cannot stay one function. Every OTHER link-builder call site — roughly 55 of them across sets/, flow/navigation.js and analysis/ — is UNCHANGED in source, but every one of them now EMITS a prefixed string.

§4.6 A rows 9-11, §4.4.5 — the file that makes the mount real, and the file where FD-18 and FD-19 live. Today (verified live): line 7 `import { liveAnimals } from './app/routes.js'`; lines 20-24 `const routes = [liveAnimals]`, `if (authEnabled) routes.push(signout)`, `await server.register(routes)`; line 16 registers health in its own call; line 29 registers serveStaticFiles in its own call.

AFTER — three changes, each load-bearing:
(a) `await server.register(liveAnimals, { routes: { prefix: '/live-animals' } })` as its OWN call. One register call per set, because `routes.prefix` applies to the WHOLE call. (pp-006/pp-007 add the second call for plantProducts; do not add it here, the gateway does not exist yet.)
(b) FD-19 — HOIST signout: `if (authEnabled) { await server.register([signout]) }` as its own UNPREFIXED call. Leaving signout in the array that now carries a prefix silently moves /signout to /live-animals/signout and breaks the OIDC sign-out leg. It registers fine either way, so no unit test catches it unless one is written — write it (see co-residency/router assertions below).
(c) FD-18 — add the root redirect with `server.route`, NOT inside a gateway, so it never enters a set context and never appears in either set's allRoutes:
    `server.route({ method: 'GET', path: '/', handler: (_request, h) => h.redirect(DEFAULT_SET_BASE) })`
  `DEFAULT_SET_BASE` is a single named constant ('/live-animals') declared once in this file (or in config) and referenced nowhere else as a literal — changing the default set must be a one-line edit. 302, NEVER 301: Hapi's h.redirect() defaults to 302, so do not add `.code(301)`; a 301 is cached by browsers indefinitely and would be painful to unpick when a set-picker page eventually replaces the redirect.

NO EDIT to the health register (line 16) or the serveStaticFiles register (line 29) — both are already their own server-wide calls and must stay unprefixed. Assert all three (root redirect, signout, static assets) rather than assuming.

§4.2 row 11 / §4.6 A row 4. §4.6 A row 8. Two call-site swaps: line 114 `dashboardPath()` → `dashboardRoutePath()` and line 126 `createPath()` → `createRoutePath()`. Both are route-table entries evaluated at module load; every OTHER use of dashboardPath()/createPath() in this file (redirects, startAction, listAction, view-model links) is a LINK and stays on the prefix-bearing builder. Re-check the line numbers before editing.

WHAT R7 CHANGES ABOUT THIS EDIT: under the reversed asymmetric plan, live-animals sat at prefix '' and getting this backwards produced the SAME string either way — the mistake was invisible until a prefixed set existed. Now the route builders and the link builders emit DIFFERENT strings for live-animals too, so a mix-up fails on the first request: a dropped prefix gives a link to `/notifications/...` (404), a doubled prefix registers the route at `/live-animals/live-animals` (404). That is the point of the symmetry.

§4.6 A rows 5-7 — THE ONE BEHAVIOURAL TRAP IN THIS INCREMENT. Read all three rows before touching the file.

Row 5 (mechanical): line 1 imports BASE and line 13 is `const JOURNEY_PREFIX = `${BASE}/notifications/`` — a MODULE-LOAD capture, which is precisely the bug class co-residency cannot tolerate. AFTER: import setBase and make it a function, `const journeyPrefix = () => `${setBase()}/notifications/``, called at each use inside the guard (per request). Do not memoise it.

Row 6 (BEHAVIOURAL — get this wrong and the deep-link guard is SILENTLY DISABLED): lines 16 and 18 do `path.startsWith(JOURNEY_PREFIX)` and `path.slice(JOURNEY_PREFIX.length)` against `request.path`. Under a Hapi mount prefix, `request.path` INCLUDES the prefix (`/live-animals/notifications/J`). Today BASE === '' makes the guard's prefix and the request path agree BY ACCIDENT. Once mounted, BOTH the startsWith test and the slice length must use the prefixed `journeyPrefix()` — which they do automatically if and only if you use the function everywhere and never a stale const. Pin it with a unit test that feeds a request whose `path` carries the prefix and asserts the journey id extracted by the slice is the bare id (no leading segment left over, no characters eaten).

Row 7: line 16 also compares `path === createPath()`; createPath() is now prefixed too, so it still agrees with `request.path` — consistent, but pin it with a test rather than reasoning about it.

Name this pattern in the commit message: it is the exemplar every future set's entry guard must follow, and pp-053's add-a-set.md warns about it by name.

notes:
RULING R7 (Sam, 2026-08-01, later session): SYMMETRIC MOUNTS — FD-16 IS REVERSED. Sam does not accept live-animals keeping the root while only plant-products is prefixed: 'this stuff is still in development, refactoring live-animals is fine — have them match up; changing URLs if required, just make sure to update the -tests repo as well.' BOTH sets mount under `/<setId>`. live-animals' URLs MOVE to /live-animals. That is the whole character of this increment: it is a URL MIGRATION, not a no-op platform change.

THE ACCEPTANCE BAR THAT WAS DELETED. The round-2 version of this increment said: 'with live-animals still the only registered set, EVERY existing URL assertion in the repo passes UNEDITED — that is the proof the root mount is genuinely a no-op.' That bar is now WRONG in both directions: zero spec edits would mean the mount did nothing, and an assertion that survives the migration unchanged is an assertion that never tested the prefix. The replacement is the 8-point bar above: an explicit enumerated migration proven by UPDATED, FRONT-ANCHORED assertions.

WHY SYMMETRY IS SAFER, NOT JUST TIDIER (the trap R7 removes). Under the asymmetric plan live-animals sat at prefix '', so a DOUBLED prefix (setBase() used where a route shape was wanted) and a DROPPED prefix (a route shape used where a link was wanted) produced the SAME correct-looking string for live-animals — `'' + '/notifications'` is `/notifications` either way. The bug could only ever surface on the plant side, in code the live-animals suite never exercises, and the 'every live-animals assertion passes unedited' bar would have actively certified it as fine. With neither set at '', both mistakes fail visibly for BOTH sets on the first request. Symmetry costs one enumerated migration once; asymmetry costs a permanent special case in shared/paths.js, registerSetMount and add-a-set.md, plus a hidden bug class.

WHY THE ROUTE-SHAPE / LINK SPLIT IS UNAVOIDABLE (FD-4): shared/kit.js:120-133 calls pageRoutePath(slug) at MODULE LOAD when it builds pageRoutes, long before any configure* seam runs and with no request in flight. Route paths therefore CANNOT come from request context. Hapi's plugin `routes.prefix` supplies the mount instead, so route-shape builders stay prefix-free; only the link builders, which run per request, resolve setBase().

THIS INCREMENT IS ATOMIC AND CANNOT BE SPLIT. The moment live-animals is registered under a prefix, every unmigrated call site is broken. Splitting it (platform first, specs later) leaves the repo red between increments, which the build loop treats as a failure. All of §4.6 A-D lands here, in one commit if possible.

THE MOUNT TABLE this increment makes real (§4.3): live-animals prefix '/live-animals' → dashboard /live-animals, create /live-animals/notifications, hub /live-animals/notifications/{journeyId}, page /live-animals/notifications/{journeyId}/{slug}. plant-products (pp-007) takes the identical shapes under /plant-products. Route shapes are declared prefix-free and byte-identical between the sets; Hapi supplies the mount. A route registered as '/' under prefix '/live-animals' is served at '/live-animals' with NO trailing slash.

WHAT SERVES `/` (FD-18): a server-wide 302 redirect to /live-animals, declared with server.route in router.js next to health and signout, NEVER inside a gateway (so it never enters a set context and never appears in either set's allRoutes). Chosen over a set-picker page and over a 404 because OIDC is the binding constraint: auth/controller.js falls back to '/' in five places and getSafeRedirect only permits relative paths, so a 404 at '/' would break sign-in for anyone arriving without a stored redirect.
